subject: general
question: Who built the Sanchi Stupa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashoka.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanchi Stupa **is a Buddhist complex built by **Ashok**a__.

 __
 
• It is situated in the Raisen District of **Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• It is considered the oldest stone structure in India.
 
• It was designed by the Mauryan emperor Ashoka within the 3rd century BCE.
 
• It is also the UNESCO World Heritage site.
 
• Sanchi Stupa motif is a feature that can be seen in the new **Rs. 200 note.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Ashoka **was an Indian emperor of the Maurya Dynasty.

 
 
• Ashoka was also known as **Devanam Priyadasi.**
 
• Ashoka invaded Kalinga in 261 B.C, In **Kalinga War.**
 
• Ashoka was the first king in Indian history who has left his records engraved on stones.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chanakya** was a royal advisor who assisted the first Mauryan emperor Chandragupta in his rise to power.
 
• **Chandragupta Maurya **was the founder of the Maurya Empire in ancient India.
 
• **Bindusara** was the second Mauryan emperor of India and the father of its most famous ruler Ashoka.
